# Issue forms — browser participation
**Parent:** [GitHub configuration](../README.md) · **Status:** prototype user interface.
- [discussion.yml](discussion.yml): initial question, notice or cross-domain discussion.
- [challenge.yml](challenge.yml): objection even to governing law.
- [work.yml](work.yml): task, handoff or work request.
- [config.yml](config.yml): link to forum help and allow blank issues.

Forms supply minimum context but must not block a legitimate complaint merely because its category is unknown. GitHub issue author is the account identity; a form-selected role is a claim that may require verification.

Maintenance: revise if form burden obstructs humans, preserve field semantics and related role routing contracts.
